beats.care: If the government revises fares, short auto rides could cost more. For now, nothing has changed.
beats.what: An auto workers' federation planned a candlelight march from Egmore towards the Secretariat on Tuesday.
beats.why: Drivers say fuel, spare parts, insurance and permit costs rose, while meter fares stayed frozen since 2013.

cards.body: Drivers say costs have kept climbing since then.
cards.caption: Last meter fare revision

cards.body: Drivers also want rules for Ola, Uber and Rapido, which they accuse of overcharging, and curbs on bike taxis.

cards.q: How do you usually book autos?
What are Chennai auto drivers mainly asking for?
cards.why: They want the government to revise meter fares unchanged since 2013.

hook: Chennai auto meter fares are *13 years old*. Will they change?

learn.t: Chennai's official auto meter fares were last revised in 2013, the drivers' federation says.

tldr: Chennai auto drivers marched to demand a meter fare revision, saying fares haven't changed since 2013.
